system.description:
Phantasmic Eruption – Ghostburn.

Ghostburn is treated as a Mental Condition. Creatures with it have had their chakra network overloaded by Ghostfire suffering the following effects.

A Ghostburned creature reduces the damage or healing die they roll from jutsu they cast by half.

A Ghostburned creature that makes a chakra control check to maintain concentration on a jutsu takes 6d6 chakra damage, once per turn.

A Ghostburned creature remakes their saving throw to end this condition at the end of each of their turns. They cannot make this saving throw at advantage.
system.summary: Its jutsu damage and healing dice are halved; 6d6 chakra damage when it checks to keep concentration (once per turn); a save each turn ends it.

rules.text: Its jutsu roll half the damage and healing dice. A Chakra Control check to keep concentration costs it 6d6 chakra damage (once per turn). It repeats the inflicting save at the end of each of its turns (never at advantage); a success ends it.
